newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani shrs end lower on reform uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani shrs end lower on reform uncertainty.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Sunday as investors were unsure if the reforms programme announced on Saturday could be implemented successfully, dealers said.
Shahid Javed Burki, the new finance chief of Pakistan set out a sweeping reform programme to shore up the country's crumbling economic foundation and regain the favour of IMF and World Bank.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index plunged 24.68 points, or 1.63 percent, to close at 1,492.19. Losers led gainers 165 to 51.
Hub Power Co fell 2.65 rupees to 34.60 and ICI Pakistan 0.50 to 19.80.
